text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 4.8% drop outpacing Bitcoin's 3.1%, suggesting selective pressure on altcoins and a flight toward the largest assets. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 57 but has retreated 16 points over a week, indicating sentiment is cooling from recent highs even as it remains above neutral. Bitcoin dominance at 59.4% with $87B in daily volume reflects a market consolidating rather than capitulating—traders are testing resolve but not panicking.
